tango.inspection: All 55 decoded frames inspected as one timing sheet. PASS: asymmetric counter-swing/deep coil earn the release; support narrows from both to left-dominant to left-toe then AIRBORNE; root follows one compact vertical arc while limb rotation phases around it; late opening aims the catch; lead-only first contact precedes trailing support; deepest compression occurs after support returns; rebound overshoots into right-biased settle; final ready occupies a new stance address. No reverse recoil, idle reset, equal-spacing mannequin loop, or semantic support invention survived.
